aarti.pad1: Yaśodā, overjoyed, performs the āratī; she swells with joy more than her body can hold. Saying again and again that she gives herself for him, she caresses her child; immersed in bliss, she thrills all over. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: A golden platter, a row of jewelled lamps, painted wicks soaked in ghee; with lovely vermilion, dūrvā grass, curd and unbroken rice she applies the tilaka in many ways. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: There is food of four kinds and offerings of many sorts; kettledrums of many kinds are sounding. The cowherds dance, sprinkle saffron water and give gifts of jewels to all. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Hosts of gods, men and sages shower flowers; the young women of Vraja smile. Seeing the face of Giridhara, Kṛṣṇadāsa's Lord, the lovely moon is put to shame. ॥4॥
